replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: Hey aay! Thank you for filing this report, but the consequence would not be a temp-ban. Thanks for your concern though!
replies.body_tagged: Hey aay! Thank you for filing this report, but the consequence would not be a temp-ban. Thanks for your concern though!

replies.author: ayy
replies.body: And why would it have to be a temp ban? It could always be a warn.
replies.body_tagged: And why would it have to be a temp ban? It could always be a warn.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: Yes, it would be a warn. Online reports can only result in a temp ban or a permanent ban; not a kick or warn.
replies.body_tagged: Yes, it would be a warn. Online reports can only result in a temp ban or a permanent ban; not a kick or warn.

replies.author: ayy
replies.body: Either way, if you refuse to punish him here, I'll just pass it on via skype.
replies.body_tagged: Either way, if you refuse to punish him here, I'll just pass it on via skype.

replies.author: _Avy
replies.body:
You may just have to do that then.
Warns and kicks are only punishable when a player is ingame that is why we only fulfil temp and full bans. If you were to provide more evidence then we could've given the player an infraction.
Thanks for the report though and we will keep an eye out. 
Have a great day!
